ruleDefinitions.name: Uncommon Sigverif.EXE Child Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects uncommon child processes spawning from "sigverif.exe", which could indicate potential abuse of the latter as a living of the land binary in order to proxy execution.

sequences.query: parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\sigverif\\\.exe$") AND  NOT ((process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\WerFault\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\WerFault\.exe"))
